Method

The selected region fills the generator’s spatial grid. A spatial noise schedule anchors the boundary during refinement.

01

Select a region

Select a region in the mesh and conditioning image.

02

Enlarge & re-encode

Scale the submesh to fill the generator’s spatial grid and re-encode it.

03

Refine with anchoring

Anchor boundary latents and allow stronger changes toward the interior.

04

Reintegrate

Transform the refined region back and combine it with the original asset.

Figure 2 · Overview of NOFACE3D. Given an asset generated by an off-the-shelf image-to-3D model and a user-marked region, NOFACE3D scales the region up to fill the generator’s input volume and re-encodes it into the full-resolution latent grid. A boundary-distance field assigns each token a release level τ: tokens near attachment boundaries stay anchored, and tokens farther away are regenerated more strongly. Geometry and texture are then resampled with spatially varying SDEdit, and unreleased tokens are re-anchored to the base asset at every step. Finally, the refined mesh replaces the base faces inside the crop box.

BIGDETAIL assets

Study details and metrics

Human study: 16 reviewers, 200 PAniC-3D assets, 1,188 responses. 12.0% of responses were “neither.” Of judged ratings, 12.2% preferred TRELLIS.2 and 4.5% were ties.
